title: Kyren Williams: Offensive inconsistency "probably because I'm not out there"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kyren Williams: Offensive inconsistency "probably because I'm not out there"
sources.description: Sunday's 18-16 home loss to the Cardinals dropped the Rams to 2-4 and continued a start that has many people scratching their heads given how high the hopes were for the team heading into the season.
